document.abstract: Auxiliary equipment has been designed and built in an experimental form which will automatically control the light shutter of a Bell & Howell printer. By means of silicon solar cells, a contact-making voltmeter and a 22-step selsyn transmitter device the aperture control of the printer is varied in accordance with the opacity of the negative being printed.
